dedupe_keys.name: dataset for power system forced oscillation responses

description: Dataset for Power System Forced Oscillation Responses is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Deepak Joshi. " Forced oscillation events are rare, and detailed system recordings are not publicly accessible. They are mostly anonymously shared with the community, which makes it challenging to study and analyze the different scenarios of forced oscillation events. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
